audit.why: FAV / 4/10 difficulty with a 9.5/10 carry threat is right at 56.25% over 256 games: Quinn owns levels 1-5 against a melee Kayle and loses everything after her ranged form.
audit.corrected: Difficulty ratings left alone; the trading lines were rewritten to stop calling Kayle 'he' and to key the blind to her last-hit autos rather than a generic 'trade window'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Quinn Levels 4-5, First item and Two+ items and called Level 6 'Skill', while the whys captioning those exact rows say Kayle's ranged form takes over and 'the late belongs entirely to her'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle and the already-audited mirror flipped rows 3-6 to Kayle. The why-text on this side already describes the shift, so no prose invention is needed.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped to Kayle in matched full/content pairs; rows 0-2 stay Quinn. Spike ladder (lvl 1-3 punish, lvl 6 roam, 1st item ranged form, late R invuln) is accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Celestial Blessing's heal and Starfire Spellblade's auto-attack reset are never mentioned, and Divine Judgment is described with no cooldown, so 'bait it' has no cost attached.
audit.why: Kayle W is flagged heal on a flat 15s; E is flagged autoReset on 8/7.5/7/6.5/6; R is 160/120/80s. Both W and E appear in missingInteractions for this matchup.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and the trading blocks now carry the 160s R, the 15s heal with its Grievous Wounds requirement, and the 8s E reset as the step-back cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, sequencingCues 0.

audit.corrected: Concrete numbers written into the cooldown block, the do's and report[5].

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 — her get-out at 6, so bait it before you commit. - Celestial Blessing: a flat 15s heal, so anti-heal early. - Starfire Spellblade: an 8s auto reset.

edits.before: Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 160s invulnerability at rank 1 — bait it out, then commit.
